The '''''Lazy Katarn''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ''Katarn'' traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], where it's crew rescued the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] child [[Caeleb]] from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]]. However, Caeleb was kidnapped by Rystra several months later, so the crew of the ''Katarn'' set out to find him. The flew it to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they followed a lead. They then flew it to the planet [[Pamorjal]], where they had tracked Rystra to. However, the ''Katarn'' was destroyed when it was attacked by members of the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], a resistance group that operated on Pamorjal.
